zh: 打开 NetworkConsole Lite 后，概览页立即显示网络路径和健康状态
en: After launching NetworkConsole Lite, the overview shows the network path and health status

zh: 网络接口页列出 Wi-Fi、有线、VPN 相关接口和地址
en: The Interfaces page lists Wi-Fi, wired, and VPN-related interfaces with addresses

zh: DNS 与路由页显示解析器来源、DNS 服务器和默认网关
en: DNS & Route shows resolver source, DNS servers, and the default gateway

zh: 外网探测页展示 Apple、Cloudflare、Google 的成功率、延迟和丢包近似
en: Internet probes show success rate, latency, and loss approximation for public endpoints

zh: 本地时间线记录网络变化和每次检查，数据仅保存在本机
en: The local timeline records network changes and every check, stored only on this Mac

zh: 设置页支持中英文切换，并显示当前版本信息
en: Settings supports Chinese and English switching and shows the current version
